missing_h97d_signals.required_evidence: Exact H97D signed CAN service and onGearStatusChanged P/N/R/D plus sleep/wake trace; getGearStatus is a cached snapshot.
Exact producer, units, invalid-state handling and fresh zero-speed feedback on H97D; an integer display cache cannot establish stationary telemetry.
Each door position must have a qualified producer and fresh open/closed feedback. A lock-change DoorStatus callback can carry old position fields.
H97D outside-temperature producer, scale, validity and wake trace; ambient callback data remains unqualified.
H97D DRIVING_MODE_SET_FB mapping and controller trace. DRIVING_MODE_SET and setter receipts are request echoes, not actual mode.
